sql: SELECT pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(current_database())) AS db_size, (SELECT max(captured_at) FROM positions) AS last_position, (SELECT max(created_at) FROM live_orders) AS last_live_order, (SELECT max(filled_at) FROM fills) AS last_fill, (SELECT max(created_at) FROM paper_trades) AS last_paper_trade, (SELECT max(captured_at) FROM mmsell_position_ticks) AS last_tick, now() AS now_utc
